caption: The drawing depicts a person shown from the waist up, with a focus on their face, upper torso, and arms. The person has short, dark hair and is wearing a loose, light-colored garment with red circular elements on the sleeves, suggestive of buttons. Their skin is rendered with a combination of creamy and peach tones, with some shading to indicate depth around the neck and arms. The hands are positioned in front of the body, holding a round object that is only partially sketched and is accented with black and gray lines. Around the figure, there are numerous handwritten annotations pointing to different features and colors used in the drawing, such as "flesh," “black,” “yellow worn patch," and "orange." The background is plain and uncolored, and there are a few brush marks in the upper right and lower left corners. The overall composition places the figure centrally with most details and color focused on the face, arms, and the object being held, while the rest is sketchy and unfinished.
title: Sketch of Figurehead
